hypothesis: Rebalancing to equal weight among assets with high volatility and imperfect correlation captures a rebalancing return that scales with cross-sectional dispersion, and low/mid-cap crypto has the highest dispersion of any liquid asset class. Capturing it requires trading against recent momentum at exactly the sizes where large capital cannot transact. Turnover is bounded by construction at one full rebalance per year, which is the only reason this fits the gate at all.
notes: The only hypothesis of the four whose turnover cannot drift.
Dispersion is measured on the panel and reported; if realized dispersion is not materially above the ETF panel's, the mechanism is absent and the test is uninformative rather than negative.
refutation: REFUTED if annual equal-weight rebalancing does not beat buy-and-hold of the IDENTICAL basket, net of the measured cost model, over the holdout. The comparison is against the same names deliberately: any difference is then attributable to the rebalancing itself and not to selection. PRIOR EVIDENCE AGAINST, declared here rather than discovered later: on the ETF panel, equal_weight_quarterly returned -6.0% against its benchmark with an information ratio of -0.304. Five ETFs are the lowest-dispersion case available and crypto low-caps the highest, which is why the hypothesis survives that result, but it is a real prior and a second negative would be decisive.

benchmark: equal-weight buy-and-hold of the same point-in-time universe
selection_criterion.construction: annual rebalance to equal weight vs buy-and-hold of the identical basket, both net of the same measured costs
selection_criterion.costs: docs/CRYPTO_LOWCAP_COST_MODEL.md measured model, p75 quantile, $1,000 order size, non-executable books = no trade

also_reported: DSR with observed variance, new ledger only
DSR with the 109-trial ETF ledger combined (N=124)
deflated_sharpe.n_trials_policy: the DECLARED budget is used even if fewer are spent
deflated_sharpe.sharpe_variance_floor_source: cross-trial variance of the 109-trial ETF ledger
deflated_sharpe.variance_policy: max(observed across this experiment's trials, floor)

selection_criterion.power_limitation_declared: a 2.69-year holdout has a standard error of roughly 0.75 on an annualized Sharpe, so it cannot separate a true Sharpe of 1.0 from 0; the verdict is a range, not a point, and will be reported as one
selection_criterion.validation: walk-forward with embargo, same methodology as the ETF study

universe: membership: point-in-time CMC snapshot at each date, cmc_id identity
screen: cmc_rank <= 1000 on the rebalance date
tradability: venue klines required on the rebalance date (bybit or binance spot USDT)
prices: venue klines only; snapshot prices are cross-check, never execution
excluded: stablecoins (declared filter), coins with no vetted-venue listing
